I love the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7733]Taller and Cuter Sebastian Sprite[/url] mod, but I just got to the winter season and found that there's no winter sprites. Thus, here is the birth of this unofficial update. Once again, all file assets are by Akumea. I simply drew scarves over their sprites.

All original assets are included. I just added the winter sprite sheet to the files. [b]You must replace the original mod file with this one[/b] since I edited the content.json (the file that runs alongside Content Patcher).
